project_info.name: RPS Grade 4 Programming Homework Portal (2026/2027)
project_info.description: Grade 4 Programming Homework Portal with student packages, daily tasks, exam monitoring, anti-cheat security, and PostgreSQL/Supabase backend.

environment_variables.description: Secret key used for signing JWT tokens

ai_activity_logs.author: Antigravity AI
ai_activity_logs.action: Created vibecode-log.json and updated backend auto-migration for Supabase deployment.
ai_activity_logs.issue_diagnosed: Render backend failed on launch with error: 'relation "users" does not exist' because Supabase DB was empty and init.sql was not automatically executed on startup.
changes_made: Created vibecode-log.json in project root directory for context sharing across devices.
Updated backend/index.js initDB() to execute backend/init.sql automatically on startup if tables are missing.
Added auto-seeding in initDB() for admin account (admin/admin123), student accounts, and curriculum topics/questions from CSV.
ai_activity_logs.instructions_for_next_ai: When starting on a new device, check DATABASE_URL environment variable in Render. On deployment, node index.js will execute init.sql to build tables automatically and seed default data. Default admin login is admin/admin123.

ai_activity_logs.author: Antigravity AI
ai_activity_logs.action: Fixed homework exit navigation & enforced student package access security.
ai_activity_logs.issue_diagnosed: Exiting a homework assignment directed students to homework/homework-X/index.html (Homework Package Grid) instead of Student Dashboard (../../index.html), allowing students to view and access other students' homework packages.
changes_made: Updated all exit/back links across all homework HTML files and scripts (generate-homeworks.js, setup-homework-2.js) to point directly to '../../index.html' (Student Dashboard).
Enhanced js/security.js to block students from viewing package files that do not belong to them, automatically redirecting non-owners to '../../index.html'.
Updated js/homework-loader.js to filter package cards on homework/homework-X/index.html so student accounts only see their own assigned package card, while admin accounts can view all cards.
ai_activity_logs.instructions_for_next_ai: Students exiting homework will now return directly to the Student Dashboard (../../index.html). If a student attempts to open another student's homework URL, security.js will block access and redirect to the Student Dashboard.
